# DebateLab by Programcode

DebateLab is the official AI debate preparation platform by Programcode at https://debate.pi-stack.org/.

Important public pages:
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/ — homepage
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/debatelab — official DebateLab page
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/debatelab-by-programcode — brand and app overview
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/what-is-debatelab — plain-English product definition
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/debatelab-ai — AI debate practice overview
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/about-debatelab — about page

Product summary: DebateLab helps students, coaches, and competitive debaters generate cases, practice rebuttals, find evidence leads, map argument flowcharts, ask for coaching, and time speeches.
